name: Trish Magyari
reason: Mainly clinical: her own site (trishmagyari.com, read 10 Nov 2026) leads with mindfulness-based psychotherapy and psychosocial genetic counselling, frames everything as trauma-informed (blog on practising during trauma), and its offerings are MBSR/MSC classes with professional CEs; it was last updated for 2021 (latest dated retreat Dec 2021-Jan 2022), so too little current, non-clinical teaching to list.
